Get KBL Player Box Score

Source: R/kbl.R
kbl_player_box.Rd

Player box score of a final game with the vendor's advanced rates, one row per player of both teams.

Endpoint: GET https://api.kbl.or.kr/match/{gmkey}/player-stat

Usage

kbl_player_box(gmkey)

Arguments

gmkey

Game key S{seasonCode}G{gameCode}N{gameNo}, e.g. 'S47G01N49' (the 2025-26 regular season's game 49): season_code, game_code and game_no of kbl_schedule. Only final games are served; a malformed key is a hoopR_bad_request.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Player box score of a final game with the vendor's advanced rates, one row per player of both teams. The columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py kbl_player_box); an empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data, a valid body with no rows for this frame is a zero-row tibble:

col_nametypedescription
gmkeycharacterGame key S{seasonCode}G{gameCode}N{gameNo} (e.g. S47G01N49): the id of every game route and game frame.
season_codeintegerKBL season code: one sequential number over every season and D-League edition (47 = 2025-26, 48 = the 2025 D-League).
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26), derived from season_code through the crosswalk (kbl_codes.SEASONS).
game_codecharacterCompetition inside the season, two digits: 01 regular season, 03 playoffs, 04 final, 07 EASL, 08 D-League stage 2, 10 All-Star, 11/13 cups, 14 Open Match Day.
game_nointegerGame number inside the competition (glkey): the N part of the gmkey.
team_codecharacterKBL team code (2-digit string, e.g. '50' = Changwon LG). Joins to /common/teamList teamCode, game tcodeH/tcodeA, t in text-cast. Not stable across ownership changes: the Anyang club is '40' (SBS) in 1997-98 and '70' today. D-League sides have their own codes (teamCodeD).
home_awaycharacterSide (string): '1' home, '2' away; '3' on both teams' rows in the 1997-98 sample, so join on player.tcode instead.
startedinteger1 when the player started the game, else 0.
pcodecharacterKBL player code (6-digit string). Joins to pcode on every route and to playerNo in /league/round-mvp.
player_namecharacterPlayer name in Korean (foreign players in Hangul transliteration).
player_name_encharacterPlayer name in English / romanized (sometimes Hangul for former players).
team_namecharacterTeam short name (Korean, e.g. Changwon LG), as it was at the time. English names: /common/teamList teamNameEn / teamNameFullEn, joined on the team code.
back_numcharacterJersey number (string).
poscharacterPosition code (string): C center, FD forward, GD guard, FC forward-center, GF guard-forward; table in the returns md.
player_flagcharacterPlayer type (string): '0' domestic, '1' foreign import, '2' Asian-quota player.
scoreintegerPoints. This game.
fgintegerTwo-point field goals made, dunks included: 201 + 207 rows (score = 2fg + 3threep + ft holds on every sampled box). This game.
fg_aintegerTwo-point field-goal attempts, made + missed, dunks included: 201 + 202 + 207 + 208 rows (checked per team on S47G01N49). This game.
fgtintegerField goals made, two- and three-point (fg + threep). This game.
fgt_aintegerField-goal attempts, two- and three-point (fgA + threepA). This game.
threepintegerThree-point field goals made (action 205). This game.
threep_aintegerThree-point attempts, made + missed (205 + 206). This game.
ftintegerFree throws made (action 203). This game.
ft_aintegerFree-throw attempts, made + missed (203 + 204). This game.
dkintegerDunks made (action 207); included in fg. This game.
dk_aintegerDunk attempts (made + missed, actions 207 + 208). This game.
rbintegerTotal rebounds (offr + defr; team rebounds are teamR). This game.
offrintegerOffensive rebounds (action 209). This game.
defrintegerDefensive rebounds (action 210). This game.
astintegerAssists (action 211). This game.
stlintegerSteals (action 212). This game.
bsintegerBlocked shots (action 213). This game.
tointegerTurnovers (action 214). This game.
foulintegerPersonal fouls (wft + woft). This game.
wftintegerFouls that awarded free throws (action 215). This game.
woftintegerFouls that awarded no free throws (action 216). This game.
ppintegerField goals made in the paint. This game.
pp_aintegerField-goal attempts in the paint. This game.
pscoreintegerPoints in the paint (2 * pp). This game.
sastintegerScreen assists (action 226; tracked in recent seasons only, 0 before). This game.
dflintegerDeflections (action 227; tracked in recent seasons only, 0 before). This game.
gdintegerGood-defense plays (action 221). This game.
idfintegerIllegal-defense violations (action 219; an early-KBL rule, so non-zero only in old seasons). This game.
fbintegerFast breaks credited to the player (action 217 rows that name a player, as in 1997-98); 0 in recent seasons, where fast breaks are team rows (tfb). This game.
efintegerMeaning unverified (0 in every game sample; non-zero in some season totals). This game.
tfintegerProbably technical fouls (unverified; 0 in most rows). This game.
inoutintegerTimes the player entered the game, the start included (checked on the 2025-26 sample game); a team row sums its players. This game.
inout1integerTimes the player was substituted out before the end (checked on the 2025-26 sample game); a team row sums its players. This game.
play_minintegerMinutes of playing time; add playSec seconds. This game.
play_secintegerSeconds part of the playing time (0-59), added to playMin. This game.
fointegerFouls drawn (the player rows of a team sum to the opponent's foul, checked on the 2025-26 sample game). This game.
margin_cnintegerPlus-minus: the point margin while the player was on court. This game.
offrtgdoubleOffensive rating: points scored per 100 possessions (estimated). This game.
defrtgdoubleDefensive rating: points allowed per 100 possessions (estimated). This game.
netrtgdoubleNet rating: offrtg - defrtg. This game.
efg_rtdoubleEffective field-goal percentage, 0-100. This game.
ts_rtdoubleTrue-shooting percentage, 0-100. This game.
ast_rtdoubleAssist rate: share of teammates' field goals assisted while on court, 0-100. This game.
ast_todoubleAssist-to-turnover ratio. This game.
ast_ratiodoubleAssist ratio: assists per 100 possessions used. This game.
oreb_rtdoubleOffensive-rebound percentage, 0-100. This game.
dreb_rtdoubleDefensive-rebound percentage, 0-100. This game.
reb_rtdoubleTotal-rebound percentage, 0-100. This game.
pacedoublePossessions per 40 minutes (estimated; a player row covers his minutes on court). This game.
tov_rtdoubleTurnover rate: turnovers per 100 possessions, 0-100. This game.
possdoublePossessions (estimated). This game.
perdoublePlayer efficiency rating (KBL's formula; scale unverified). This game.
piedoublePlayer impact estimate: share of the game's positive events, as a percentage. This game.
usg_rtdoubleUsage rate: share of team possessions used while on court, 0-100. This game.
to_ratiodoubleTurnover ratio: turnovers per 100 possessions used. This game.
minutes_playeddoublePlaying time in minutes (play_min + play_sec / 60), derived.

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these wrappers read api.kbl.or.kr, the data API behind the www.kbl.or.kr React site (stats vendor sports2i). No key, cookie or proxy is needed, but two request headers must be present (Channel and TeamCode; the runtime sends WEB and XX). www.kbl.or.kr/robots.txt returns the SPA's HTML and api.kbl.or.kr/robots.txt a 500 error envelope, so no policy or Crawl-delay is published (checked 2026-10-12); the site's terms (/terms/list) were not reviewed for data reuse. The runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Not wrapped: the site's /record/* and /player/player/{pcode} pages are rendered by the sports2i widget from two other hosts (kbl-api.sports2i.com and api-stats.kbl.or.kr: team four factors, clutch, hustle, shot dashboards, all-time leaders) and need their own intake. WKBL (the women's league) is out of scope by owner ruling.

  • Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26). KBL numbers seasons AND D-League (reserve league) editions with one sequential seasonCode; division picks 'kbl' or 'd_league' and game_code the competition inside the season, and the wrapper sends the API's glkey. The playoff routes take the REGULAR-SEASON key; the old route serves seasonCode below 45 and the new one 45 on, and the wrapper picks it.

  • Ids: gmkey S{seasonCode}G{gameCode}N{gameNo} (a string, an object only inside the new playoff bracket), team_code (two-digit string with a leading zero, not stable across ownership changes) and pcode (six-digit string, the same on every route). The play-by-play carries no pcode: join its player_name to the game's box score on name and team_code. isEnded is unreliable (0 on every finished game through 2005-06), so a game is final when isEnded is 1 or when it is dated before today (KST), both teams scored and its play-by-play reached the game-end row; anything else raises hoopR_asset_fetch. The first game call also fetches the header (and, for such a game, the play-by-play) once; the answer is cached for the process.

  • Coverage: box scores and play-by-play from the first season (1997); shot x/y from 2006-07 (an earlier game's shot chart is empty: a zero-row tibble); advanced rates are filled from 1997-98 on (the vendor computes them from the box); screen assists and deflections are 0 before the recent seasons. fg is TWO-point field goals made (dunks included), fgt all field goals, and a made dunk is its own row in the play-by-play. Shot x/y are pixels on the site's 726 x 412 full-court image; basket names the target end and teams switch at half-time, so normalise with basket before stacking shots.

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, or the API has nothing for the request: an empty list, a final game with no box score, no playoff bracket, no rounds, no schedule rows in the window), hoopR_bad_request (a malformed gmkey, a season that is not an END year between 1997 and 2027, an unknown division or game_code, or bad schedule dates, raised before any request) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other non-2xx including the unknown-id HTTP 500 and the HTTP 400 the API answers without its two headers, the KBL error envelope, an empty or non-JSON body, a game that is not final, or a body for another game, season or window than the one asked for). HTTP 500 is the API's deterministic answer to an unknown id and is not retried. Wrappers raise; they never warn and return empty.
